meta.description: Simulation study for 'Shock and Contagion' (Paper 2). Synthetic data only; no real incidents.

seeds.scheme: SeedSequence([BASE_SEED, 5, 0, chunk]); estimates reuse the E1 replicates

summary.note: B includes clusters rooted in other shocks (B = B^mu + O); Con = online-channel contagion (paths with >= 1 online->offline step), sigma = Con/C.

seeds.scheme: hom: SeedSequence([BASE_SEED, 3, n_index, rep]); het: SeedSequence([BASE_SEED, 3, 100 + case_index, rep])

summary.note: corrected_est_p: p_hat = clip(p (1 + p_rel_se Z), 0.02, 1), SE(p_hat) = p_rel_se * p_hat, independent of the data; CIs from eq:th-delta. Missing SE (alpha on the boundary) counts as non-coverage.

summary.sup_lr_bootstrap: not run: lrt_alpha_zero_sup with n_boot = 99 needs ~600 EM fits per dataset, beyond the compute budget; the common-beta LRT is the one studied

seeds.scheme: SeedSequence([BASE_SEED, 2, config_index, rep]); config_index 0-11 = main configurations (T = 1000), 12-13 = long-window configurations (rare family, kappa = 2, 4; T = 10000)

summary.note: alpha = fitted branching ratio n_hat; n_eff = alpha * mean(1 - exp(-beta (T - t_l))) = share of events EM attributes to self-excitation (differs from alpha when beta_hat T is small). ridge: fits with beta_hat * T < 1 (weak identification of alpha; n_eff remains interpretable). long_T rows: rare family, constant background only, T = 10000.

augment.what: revision: long-window configurations (indices 12-13) run; main replicates (indices 0-11) kept from the main run; summary recomputed by e2_summarise (ridge rule beta_hat * T < 1, medians, shots per path)

seeds.scheme: rep: SeedSequence([BASE_SEED, 6, 0, rep]); threshold pilot: SeedSequence([BASE_SEED, 6, 999, 0])

summary.note: c_FA = 1, c_miss = ratio, pi* = 1/(1+ratio). fitted = plug-in EM fit on [0, T_train]. Delays only on the target (offline) stream; outcomes are settled counts. fitted_ht_delay plugs the HT state into the cluster continuation (no state-uncertainty integration). state ratios use the true parameters; theory_ratio_naive = E exp(-beta D) holds under stationarity without shocks.

postprocess.what: summary.calibration_by_new_shock and reps[].new_shock added by run_experiments.py --postprocess-e6 (calendars regenerated from the seeds)
